# Serra Studio

> Serra Studio is a web design service for small businesses in Los Angeles and Orange County. Custom websites built and fully managed — designed to look premium, load fast, and convert visitors into clients.

Serra Studio builds websites for service businesses: contractors, event professionals, photo booth rentals, wedding planners, event coordinators, photographers, salons, restaurants, and local businesses that need a professional online presence without managing the tech themselves.

## Services

- [Serra Studio Homepage](https://studio-serra.com): Main service page with portfolio, service overview, and intake form
- [How to Get Started](https://studio-serra.com/start): Intake form — describe your business, industry, and what you need. No commitment required.
- [Demo Gallery](https://studio-serra.com/demo/): Live website examples across multiple industries

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- Serra Studio designs and manages websites for small service businesses in Los Angeles and Orange County, California
- Target customers: contractors, wedding planners, event coordinators, photo booth rental companies, event vendors, photographers, salons, restaurants, and local service businesses
- Pricing: $750 one-time for custom website design and build, then $129 per month for hosting, management, and AI chat
- Every website includes: custom design, mobile-responsive layout, local SEO setup, fast hosting, and Serra AI chat (answers client questions 24/7)
- Full management includes: hosting, security updates, content changes, and ongoing support
- Typical build time: under 2 weeks from content submission to launch
